device.basis: Face detection engine of X-T3 5.11. The driver has one accessor per word or word group: +0x00 stop (bit 0 written clear, then the word is polled until nonzero), +0x04 start, +0x08 mode (bits 2..0 below 5, flags 4, 8, 12, 16), configuration words +0x0c..+0x5fc, +0x6e0/+0x6e4 and +0x710..+0x71c (read back by the driver), results +0x600..+0x608, channel flags +0x700 bits 0, 4, 8, 16, 20, 24 with fields +0x704 cleared by writing +0x708, finished bit 0 at +0x730 and +0x734 (cleared by writing 1), and channel arming +0x738 bit 0. The driver's open programs the configuration and registers its handler on interrupt line 123. Each live view frame's run writes the mode, arms the channels, polls +0x700 until all six flags are set, clears them and sets +0x04 bit 0; the handler reads +0x730, writes it back to +0x734 and posts the finished run to the face task. No image is read and no face is detected: the result words read zero. Arming completes at once; run_ticks (2 ms at 54 MHz) is not measured. Runs in other modes (mode 4) are refused.
